headline: Newly Appointed Chief Justice Arrives At High Court With Only A Fully Packed Picnic Basket
body:
The local legal community was left in a state of quiet confusion this morning after a newly appointed Chief Justice arrived at the High Court carrying nothing but a wicker picnic hamper and a vintage thermos. Witnesses report that upon being directed toward the chambers, the official politely declined all case dockets, expressing a firm belief that the current list of pending litigation was ‘hardly the vibe for a Tuesday picnic.’

“We had prepared the constitutional benches and a mountain of urgent stay orders, but the new Chief Justice spent the entire morning teaching the senior clerks how to properly fold a linen napkin,” remarked an administrative officer who wished to remain anonymous. “He kept pointing at the high ceilings and insisting that the acoustics were far better suited for a light jazz ensemble than for cross-examinations.”

By midday, the court premises had been transformed into an impromptu lunch spot, with the Justice reportedly using a collection of old legal gazettes as makeshift placemats. While court proceedings have remained strictly on hold, the canteen staff has noted a 400% increase in demand for cucumber sandwiches and artisanal lemonades, leaving the bar association to reconsider whether the judicial robe serves better as a cape or a picnic blanket.
